_comment: Public addresses of the cmdk hackathon build. Testnet only: Base Sepolia (chain 84532) and NEAR testnet. No keys. Base part from executor/deployments-2026-11-04.json (executor deployed 4 Nov 2026; the prototype executor 0xB23e0d7e1D0182Db7f6f2637EC4Ac51c10290f40 is retired), agent/src/chain.rs and the executor's on-chain config; read 3 Nov 2026.

tokens._comment: usdc is Circle's Base Sepolia test USDC (faucet.circle.com); dusdc is our test token for the demo market, 6 decimals, anyone may mint

chainlink._comment: the feeds the agent reads (agent/src/chain.rs) and the executor's feed-age gates for live and backup (Executor.config)

mockOracle._comment: the demo market's oracle; only the team's test wallet can set its price (scripts/rebalance_pool.py --market demo --set-price)

live._comment: USDC/WETH, MorphoChainlinkOracleV2 on the real Chainlink ETH/USD and USDC/USD feeds; pool is the public USDC/WETH 0.01% pool, kept at the oracle by scripts/rebalance.sh

backup._comment: its own MorphoChainlinkOracleV2 instance on the same two feeds; the executor's config gives it the live market's pool

demo._comment: dUSDC/WETH on the mock oracle; WETH/dUSDC 0.01% pool owned in practice by our anchor and bands

near._comment: filled on 4 Nov 2026 at the public testnet deployment (DEPLOY.md step 7; moved forward from Fri 6): vault_code_hash is base58, vault_code_hash_hex the same SHA-256 in hex; vault is v1.<factory>; vault_base_address is the vault's derived Base Sepolia address

feeds._comment: demo feeds published by the cmdk team for the testnet demo; not a real venue. Served from the public repository's raw GitHub URL (feeds/README.md)
